scope: Model freeze only; not an external validation protocol or performance claim.

target.time_basis: reconstructed from Appendix Figure S3 end-of-growth-curve criterion and the per-isolate source workbook crosswalk

development_cohort.source: Pereira et al. 2021, Figure S3 source workbook
development_cohort.role: development only; never count as external test

feature_rule: Use the last observed isolate OD at or before 18 h; do not interpolate or extrapolate.

model.standardization: mean and population standard deviation (ddof=0) calculated on the full nine-isolate development cohort; constant scale replaced with 1

prohibitions: No external-label access, external refitting, recalibration, or threshold selection.
Do not overwrite the original leave-one-population-out protocol, code, or results.
Do not describe model fitting as external validation, prospective selection, assay savings, or wet-lab gain.
future_validation_requirements: An independent cohort from new ALE populations of the same Producer_F background.
Same predeclared process and a fixed 57 h fumarate-titer target; verify assay and process alignment before calling it external validation.
Record population, isolate, culture, sample, assay, measurement time, result-availability time, and blind code.
Freeze predictions and selection decisions before endpoint labels are available.
Compare with random selection and the preregistered early-OD baseline at the independent-population level.
